bio.jane/contract.question: Write these molecules as one structure file.

description: Write a list of small molecules as one file: SDF (V2000 or V3000), each record named and, optionally, carrying its canonical SMILES and RDKit descriptors as data fields; or SMILES or CXSMILES, one record a line followed by its name. Written as RDKit's SDWriter, MolToSmiles and MolToCXSmiles write it; a structure RDKit cannot read is left out and its index returned.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

format.description: the file format. Values: sdf (SDF), sdf-v3000 (SDF V3000), smiles (SMILES), cxsmiles (CXSMILES).

molecules.description: the structures: one SMILES or molfile per entry.

names.description: a name per structure, in the same order (the SDF title line, the SMILES second column).

with_properties.description: SDF only: add canonical_smiles and the RDKit descriptors to each record as data fields.

name: write_structure_library

summary.description: how many structures were written, of how many given, and which were left out

unread.description: 0-based indices of the entries RDKit could not read, left out of the file
